title: Choose RandomChatly's love-themed world
question: The roll assigned Moonflower. Keep it, take Love Letters, or re-roll. Fonts stay Outfit + Plus Jakarta Sans.

options.label: Moonflower
options.lineage: night-blooming gardens: flowers that open only after dark
options.thesis: Some things only open at night. A stranger, a bud, and maybe a bloom by morning.
options.viewport: Match tab: plum night ground, a single line-drawn moonflower bud centred; while searching its petals slowly open; when a stranger is found it blooms and the chat slides in. Rose 'Find a Match' pill in thumb reach.
options.risk: Flowers can turn cute or wellness-app soft; the bloom must stay a fine line drawing, never an emoji or a pastel illustration.

raised.raise: One dominant shape per screen: the bloom owns the Match tab; nothing competes with it.
Vast quiet ground: the plum night stays mostly empty; restraint carries the intimacy.
Every divider is a 1px hairline; no cards inside cards.
Rank by weight and case before size: few type sizes, clear steps.
Nothing vanishes: ended chats stay visible in history, marked, not deleted.
State changes happen in place (the same bud opens); no screen swaps for status.

options.label: Love Letters
options.thesis: Every match is a letter from someone you haven't met yet.
options.viewport: Match tab: a sealed midnight envelope; searching, the wax seal pulses; matched, the seal breaks and the chat unfolds like a letter.
options.risk: Familiar: paper-and-wax romance is a well-worn look and can drift toward cream stationery.

options.label: Zoo Gardens Guide Map
options.thesis: Flat colour lobes divided by coastline.
options.case: Bright and playful: reads childish for warm late-night romance.
options.kept: One dominant shape owns each screen.

options.label: Factory Catalog Sleeve
options.thesis: Coded colour strips on matte black.
options.case: Cryptic and cold; hides names people need to read.

options.label: Design Annual Plates
options.case: Gallery-white and corporate; wrong for 2am in bed.

options.label: Timetable Slide Rack
options.thesis: One type size, raked glass slides.

options.label: Jet-Age Ticket Wallet
options.kept: Nothing disappears; ended states stay visible.

options.label: Split-Flap Concourse
options.case: Public and loud; the opposite of intimate.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A mainstream dating app look, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: White screen, big profile card, coral heart button.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every dating app, and reads swipe-first rather than chat-first.
